description: Financial astrology Gann planetary lines: planet degrees seen from the Earth and from the Sun (geocentric and heliocentric) at a moment or as a time series for backtesting, with aspect offsets, Mean of 5 / Circle of 8 and the price levels for a price-per-degree scale. Financial-astrology DATA for charting and backtests, not signals: the longitude of each planet, seen from the Earth and from the Sun in one call, plus the aspect offsets you ask for (+/-90, 120...), the Optuma averages Mean of 5 and Circle of 8, speeds, retrograde flags and declinations. Snapshot ('datetime') or series ('start', 'end', 'interval' 1h..1w, up to 1000 samples, optionally unwrapped for plotting) in columns ready for pandas. With 'price_unit' and 'price_range': every price level (degree + 360 k) x unit. Each result is hashed, so a backtest can cite and replay it. Deterministic (JPL DE440, no LLM); every result carries meta.result_sha256. Price $0.20 per call via REST POST https://astro-agent.dev/v1/finance/planetary-lines (x402 or MPP); always paid, never a free call.

aspects.description: Aspect offsets added to every line (+angle and -angle). Default: the planet's own line only (conjunction).

average_method.description: 'arithmetic' mean of the 0-360 longitudes (Optuma's rule) or 'circular' (vector) mean.

averages.description: Optuma averages: mean_of_5 = (Jupiter+Saturn+Uranus+Neptune+Pluto)/5, circle_of_8 = (Mercury..Pluto)/8, in each perspective.

bodies.description: Bodies to draw. Default: Sun..Pluto (geo), Mercury..Pluto with Earth (helio).

datetime.description: A moment (snapshot): ISO 8601 with Z or an offset, e.g. '2024-01-01T00:00Z'. A local time needs 'timezone' or coordinates. Omit when giving start/end.

end.description: Series: last UTC date, YYYY-MM-DD (at most 1000 samples).

format.description: Series layout: 'columns' (pandas.DataFrame(result['series'])) or 'rows' (one object per sample).

include_declination.description: Series: also a declination column per body.

interval.description: Series sampling step, in candle-timeframe notation.

perspective.description: Geocentric, heliocentric, or both in one call (default).

price_range.description: The price window in which to list levels, e.g. {min: 30000, max: 80000}.

price_unit.description: Price per degree. With price_range: levels = (degree + 360 k) x price_unit.

start.description: Series: first UTC date, YYYY-MM-DD. Example: '2024-01-01'.

time_utc.description: Series: UTC time of day of the first sample, HH:MM.

timezone.description: IANA zone, e.g. 'Asia/Kolkata'. Optional: resolved from the coordinates, with the historical offset (DST, Local Mean Time) of that date.

unwrap.description: Series: continuous degrees (no 360 -> 0 jump), for plotting lines across a chart.

name: planetary_lines

endpoint.description: The REST route that computed it, e.g. 'western/natal'.

deterministic.description: Always true: same input, same result.

llm_used.description: Always false: no language model is involved.

payment.description: How this call was paid: protocol ('free' or 'none'), price and the free calls remaining.

reproducibility.description: How to reproduce and check this result.

result_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical 'result'; check it with verify_result_hash.

counts.description: Number of lines and price levels (snapshot) or of samples and columns (series).

lines.description: Snapshot only: one entry per line (id such as 'helio.jupiter+90', perspective, base body or average, offset, degree 0-360, position in sign; speed, retrograde flag and declination on base lines; price levels when price_unit is given).

price_levels.description: Snapshot with price_unit: every price level in price_range, sorted, with its line id.

series.description: Series only: 'columns' format = {time_utc: [...], timestamp: [...], <line id>: [...]}; 'rows' format = one object per sample.

settings.description: Settings applied: perspectives, zodiac, bodies, aspect offsets, averages and their members, frames, line id format, price formula and, for a series, interval, samples and columns.

subject.description: Snapshot only: the resolved moment (UTC, Julian days, Delta T).

warnings.description: Notes on the input or the calculation (for example an assumed noon for an unknown birth time). Present only when there is something to say.

title: Gann planetary lines
